releaseNotes:
### Minor Changes

- 5ec7579: Make EventCalendar customizable while keeping the kit editor, chips, and toolbar as defaults. Hosts can hide EventEditor, render event chips, replace the toolbar, and attach opaque `data` on SchedulerEvent.

### Patch Changes

- Updated dependencies [5ec7579]
  - @spatika/tokens@1.3.0

AccentRule.description: Short 4px marketing accent bar used under section titles.

props.name: disableGutters
props.description: Remove the gap between items and stack them as a single surface.

props.name: value
props.deprecated: Prefer wrapping with AccordionItem — value is inherited.

props.name: value
props.deprecated: Prefer wrapping with AccordionItem — value is inherited.

props.name: value
props.deprecated: Prefer wrapping with AccordionItem — value is inherited.

props.name: value
props.deprecated: Prefer wrapping with AccordionItem — value is inherited.

props.name: overlayClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the dimmer (z-index, backdrop tweaks, etc.).

AmountInput.description: Currency-prefixed amount field for finance forms.

AppHeader.description: Top application chrome — glass header with brand, optional hamburger, actions.

props.name: actions
props.description: Right-side actions

props.name: children
props.description: Center / search slot

props.name: variant
props.description:
`sticky` — in-flow glass bar.
`chrome` — fixed safe-area app chrome (journalD RootLayout).

AppSidebar.description: Desktop navigation sidebar — glass panel with sectioned nav links.

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Collapsed rail mode

Autocomplete.description: Filterable combobox. Supports single, multiple, and free-solo entry.

props.name: onChange
props.type: ((value: string | string[] | null, option?: AutocompleteOption | AutocompleteOption[] | null) => void)

AvailabilityBadge.description: Pill badge with a live pip — “available for work” treatment.

AvatarGroup.description: Overlapping avatar stack with an overflow count.

Backdrop.description: Full-viewport dimmer, typically paired with a modal or speed dial.

props.name: contained
props.description: Render in-place instead of portaling to document.body.

props.name: invisible
props.description: Skip the dimmed fill — useful as a click-catcher.

BottomSheet.description:
Glass bottom sheet (Vaul) — mobile filters, overflow menus, sheet panels.
Customize surface via className; defaults match app chrome glass-panel look.

Box.description: Generic layout primitive. Prefer Stack / Grid / Paper for structured layouts.

ButtonBase.description: Unstyled pressable — MUI ButtonBase analogue. Use Button / IconButton for styled actions.

ButtonGroup.description: Connected cluster of buttons — first/last corners stay rounded.

props.name: series
props.type: { id?: string; label?: string; color?: string; data: Array<CandleDatum | null>; }[]

Card.description: Structured content card with optional header/footer slots via subcomponents.

props.name: variant
props.description: Glass elevation level

CareerCard.description: Resume / experience card: role, company, period pill, bullets, tech tags.

CareerTimeline.description: Vertical career rail with a hairline and slot for CareerCard rows.

Chip.description: Unified chip control for filters, preferences, and layout toggles.

ChipGroup.description: Titled multi-select chip row used in admin preferences and filter panels.

props.name: variant
props.description: filter = soft pills, preference = uppercase admin chips

ChromeAttachedCaret.description:
Small pointer that visually joins a popover to its trigger.
`align="end"` matches popover `align="end"` (caret sits under the right-hand control).

CircularProgress.description: Circular indicator. Indeterminate spins; determinate fills an SVG track.

ClickAwayListener.description: Invokes `onClickAway` when a pointer event occurs outside the child.

Collapse.description:
Height collapse used by Accordion and other expandable regions.
Animates `grid-template-rows` (transform-safe; no `transition-all`).

props.name: in
props.description: When true, the child is expanded.

props.name: unmountOnExit
props.description: Keep children mounted while collapsed. Defaults to true so height can animate.

CommandSearchField.description: Frosted command / global search field with optional result dropdown.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Called when clear is pressed

ContactLink.description: Contact / social row: tinted icon well, name, handle, trailing arrow.

CoverHero.description:
Cover hero — generated / photo cover that bleeds into app chrome, floating
glass controls, a notched identity plate, and a compact sticky bar once the
hero scrolls away. Mirrors journalD StoryCoverHeader / Profile hero.

props.name: bleed
props.description: When false, keep the cover inside this frame (docs / device previews).

props.name: compactOffsetClassName
props.description: Offset used when the compact bar pins under app chrome.

props.name: variant
props.description: Profile bleeds into a tab bar; story ends at the identity plate.

CoverPattern.description:
Seeded nature-inspired cover when no cover photo is set.
Scene kind is unique per seed; colors follow hue + theme.

DataTableToolbar.description: Search + filter slot + actions row above data tables.

props.name: overlayClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the dimmer (z-index, backdrop tweaks, etc.).

DisplayHeading.description: Oversized marketing hero title. Compose with Wordmark / GradientText.

Drawer.description:
Vaul drawer root.
Disable background scaling + input repositioning by default — both break
touch hit-testing on iOS Safari / PWAs after the page has been scrolled.

props.name: onSelect
props.description:
Radix-compatible selection handler. Call `event.preventDefault()` to keep
the menu open (e.g. editor formatting actions that must retain focus).

EmptyState.description: Empty / zero-state panel for lists and dashboards.

EntityCard.description: Glass surface wrapper for entity list items.

props.name: as
props.description: Rendered HTML element. Defaults to `div`.

props.name: density
props.description: Slightly denser padding for compact lists.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Soft hover lift for interactive rows (navigation / selection).

EntityCardChip.description: Compact type / status chip for entity cards.

EntityCardMeta.description: Secondary / muted line under the title.

EntityMediaCard.description: Entity card with photo (or generated cover + initials) — contact / album tile.

props.name: fallbackLabel
props.description: Initials when no image

EventCalendar.description: Month / week / day / agenda calendar with editor, resize, recurrence, and preferences.

props.name: onSlotClick
props.type: ((slot: { start: Date; end: Date; allDay: boolean; }) => void)

props.name: renderEvent
props.description: Replace event chip contents. The kit still wraps with the click/drag trigger.

props.name: renderToolbar
props.description: Replace the toolbar. The default kit toolbar is used when omitted.

props.name: showEventEditor
props.description:
Built-in create/edit dialog. Defaults to true.
Set false when the host owns create/edit (custom schedule modal, etc.).

props.name: showPreferences
props.description: Preferences gear in the default toolbar. Ignored when `renderToolbar` is set.

props.name: toolbarTrailing
props.description: Extra controls after the view menu. Ignored when `renderToolbar` is set.

EventTimeline.description: Horizontal resource timeline — rows are resources, bars are allocations across time.

props.name: showEventEditor
props.description:
Built-in create/edit dialog. Defaults to true.
Set false when the host owns create/edit.

Fab.description: Floating action button. Use `variant="extended"` for a labeled FAB.

FilterSheet.description: Responsive filter panel used by directory, history, and similar list pages.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Desktop / `md+` control — typically a `Button` using `floatingPageChromePillClass`.

props.name: mobileTrigger
props.description: Optional compact control for small screens; defaults to `trigger` if omitted.

FloatChip.description: Frosted floating fact chip used around a marketing hero portrait.

props.name: float
props.description: CSS float animation.

props.name: live
props.description: Compact live row (green pip + uppercase label) instead of title/subtitle.

FloatingPageChromeBar.description:
Shared chrome row: identity, optional centered search, trailing actions.
`below` is a second row (mobile search, compact TOC) and is not itself a full-bleed bar.
Pass `children` to pin this bar above a nested scroller (content never slides under it).

props.name: children
props.description: Page body — scrolls independently so it cannot pass under the toolbar.

props.name: countLabel
props.description: Spoken name for the count badge, e.g. "253 people".

FloatingPageChromeSearchField.description: Search pill used in the chrome row and the mobile reveal row.

FloatingPageChromeShell.description: Shell + glass tray for pages that compose the chrome row by hand.

FormControlLabel.description: Pairs a checkbox, radio, or switch with its visible label.

FormField.description: Label + control + helper/error stack for consistent form density.

GlassCard.description: Opinionated glass surface — prefer this over raw `.glass*` class strings.

GradientText.description: Theme-colored gradient type for wordmarks and display names.

props.name: variant
props.description: `static` clips a 3-stop theme gradient; `flow` animates it.

Grid.description: 12-column CSS grid. Use `container` on the parent and breakpoint spans on items.

HeaderIconButton.description:
Square frosted toolbar control used in sticky headers and app chrome.
Fully customizable via className; children typically an icon.

props.name: badge
props.description: Unread / status count shown as a pill

IconButton.description: Compact icon-only control. Prefer {@link HeaderIconButton } inside app chrome.

IconTile.description: Horizontal domain / feature tile: icon well + italic title + caption.

props.name: title
props.type: string | (string & React.ReactPortal) | (string & React.ReactElement<unknown, string | React.JSXElementConstructor<any>>) | (string & Iterable<React.ReactNode>) | (string & Promise<AwaitedReactNode>)

InitialsAvatar.description:
Plain initials circle — use when {@link AvatarFallback} would stay hidden
without an image load cycle (e.g. no {@link AvatarImage} child).

Masonry.description: CSS multi-column masonry. Children should be block-level items.

MediaEntryCard.description:
Long horizontal entry card (story / activity style) with optional side media.
All content regions are slots for full customization.

props.name: accentClassName
props.description: Soft accent stripe when no image

props.name: mediaClassName
props.description: Override media width on sm+

props.name: anchorEl
props.description: Anchor element — typically the button that opened the menu.

MetaChip.description: Compact “powered by” chip: icon + label with a quiet ring.

MobileTabBar.description:
iOS 26-style floating liquid-glass tab bar.
Sits above the home indicator as a capsule (not a full-bleed dock).

props.name: contained
props.description:
Position inside a parent instead of the viewport, and keep the bar visible
on large screens (docs previews, device frames).

props.name: hidden
props.description: Slide the bar away (e.g. while a text field is focused on iOS).

props.name: trailing
props.description: Extra trailing control (e.g. More)

Modal.description: Low-level modal. Prefer Dialog for titled confirmations.

NativeSelect.description: Styled native `<select>` — prefer compound `Select` for custom menus.

NoSsr.description: Renders children only after mount — useful for browser-only APIs.

NotificationBell.description:
Notification trigger + glass panel list. Customize items and actions fully.
Panel uses an opaque surface so sticky page chrome (e.g. "+ Record") cannot show through.

props.name: series
props.type: { id?: string; label?: string; color?: string; data: Array<CandleDatum | null>; }[]

PageHeader.description: Page title block with optional kicker and action slot.

PageShell.description: Full-page backdrop with theme accent washes (.app-page).

props.name: padded
props.description: Include .app-shell horizontal padding.

PageStickyHeader.description:
Sticky glass page chrome — title, icon badge, search & action slots.
Matches journalD PageHeader (density, count, below row, page-header-* type).

props.name: below
props.description: Full-width row under the main toolbar (mobile search / secondary actions).

props.name: offsetClassName
props.description: Offset below a fixed app bar (defaults to top-16 → --app-chrome-offset).

props.name: title
props.type: string | (string & React.ReactPortal) | (string & React.ReactElement<unknown, string | React.JSXElementConstructor<any>>) | (string & Iterable<React.ReactNode>) | (string & Promise<AwaitedReactNode>)

Paper.description: Surface primitive. Prefer Card / GlassCard for structured content.

props.name: elevation
props.description: 0–3. Ignored when variant is outlined.

PhotoViewer.description: Full-screen photo viewer / lightbox with zoom and prev/next.

props.name: series
props.type: { data: Array<{ id?: string | number; value: number; label?: string; color?: string; }>; innerRadius?: number; paddingAngle?: number; }[]

PinPad.description: Numeric PIN pad with dot indicators. Length, copy, and styles are customizable.

props.name: onCloseAutoFocus
props.description: Radix compat — ignored.

props.name: onOpenAutoFocus
props.description: Radix compat — ignored (focus stays with the trigger by default).

Portal.description:
Renders children into `document.body` (or a provided container) via React portal.
Mounts synchronously on the client so floating content can be measured in the
same layout pass (avoids width=0 positioning flashes).

PresenceDot.description: Live status pip with optional ping halo (availability badges, hero chips).

props.name: ping
props.description: Dual-span scale ping. Defaults to true.

ProfileHero.description:
Profile / entity hero: cover fills the frame, overlapping avatar notches
the frosted identity plate. Stacked in a narrow column; left-notched once
the plate is wide enough (container query, not viewport).

props.name: bleed
props.description: When false, keep the cover inside this frame (catalog previews).

props.name: coverSeed
props.description: Seed for the generated cover when no photo is set.

ProjectCard.description: Marketing project tile: title, company, outcome pill, body, tech tags.

QuickFilterRail.description: Horizontal scroll filter rail with optional grouped sections.

props.name: activeStyle
props.description: solid = filled primary when active (directory style); soft = tinted (default chip)

QuickSettings.description: Sliding quick-settings panel — appearance, density, toggles, etc.

props.name: side
props.description: side sheet from right (default) or bottom drawer-like panel

Rating.description: Star rating. `StarRating` is the same component with a required `value`.

RichTextEditor.description:
Lightweight rich-text surface (contenteditable) for notes and captions.
Pair with TipTap or another full editor in your app when you need tables or advanced media.

SearchField.description: Search input with leading icon — mobile-friendly min height.

SectionHeading.description:
Marketing / page-section title: optional eyebrow, heading, subtitle, and accent rule.
Renders a `div` (not `<header>`) so it never competes with the site navbar.

props.name: showRule
props.description: Hide the accent rule under the copy.

SectionPanel.description: Glassmorphic settings / admin section with icon tile and uppercase subtitle.

props.name: overlayClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the dimmer (e.g. lighter backdrop).

SiteFooter.description:
Marketing-site footer: brand, copyright, links, optional meta chips.
Frosted surface bar with a primary hairline.

props.name: meta
props.description: Trailing meta row (badges, “powered by”, etc.).

props.name: renderLink
props.description: Render each link (e.g. Next.js `<Link>`). Defaults to `<a>`.

SiteNav.description:
Marketing-site navbar: fixed bar, brand, desktop links, and a 3-line mobile menu.
Transparent at rest, frosted surface after scroll.

props.name: contained
props.description:
Pin the bar to a relatively positioned parent instead of the viewport.
Use this in docs previews and embedded shells.

props.name: innerClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the inner max-width row.

props.name: renderLink
props.description: Render each link (e.g. Next.js `<Link>`). Defaults to `<a>`.

SpatikaThemeProvider.description:
MUI-style theme provider for Spatika.
Wraps the app (or a subtree) and applies theme classes / data attributes.

props.name: defaultTheme
props.description: Uncontrolled initial theme. Ignored when `storageKey` already has a value.

props.name: storageKey
props.description:
Persist the selected theme in `localStorage` under this key.
Pass `false` (default) to keep the theme in memory only.

props.name: syncDocument
props.description:
When true (default), also sync theme classes onto `document.documentElement`
so CSS variables apply globally (typical SPA / Storybook usage).

props.name: target
props.description: Optional element to theme instead of (or in addition to) document

props.name: theme
props.description: Controlled theme

props.name: hideBackdrop
props.description: Hide the dimmer behind actions.

StatCard.description: Compact metric tile using elevated app-card surface.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`app` — elevated app-card tile (label then value).
`metric` — centered value-first tile for marketing stats.

SurfaceCard.description: Profile / hierarchy surface card (primary → tertiary visual weight).

Tag.description: Static label pill for skills, tech stacks, and metadata.

TextField.description: Labeled input (or textarea) with helper / error copy — MUI TextField analogue.

TimelineItem.description: Single activity / journal row inside a Timeline.

Toaster.description: App-level toast host + provider. Wrap the app once and call useToast().

TransferList.description: Two-list shuttle for picking items — MUI Transfer List analogue.

ViewFiltersPanel.description:
View & filters panel — glass bottom sheet with clear / done chrome.
Pass arbitrary filter fields as children for full customization.

Wordmark.description: Marketing wordmark: solid name, optional gradient accent, optional primary mark.

props.name: name
props.description: Primary name, rendered in foreground.

props.name: accent
props.description: Trailing bit (`.io`, last name) in the marketing gradient.

props.name: mark
props.description: Extra punctuation in primary (the period in `Name.`).

props.name: rest
props.description: Unstyled trailing copy after the mark (`io` in `Acme.io`).
